description: Paid (small USDC payment via x402 on Algorand). Returns the Hosannaith reliability score for a target x402 endpoint URL so you can decide whether to trust it before routing payment to it. Requires the AVM_MNEMONIC environment variable on this server.

targetUrl.description: The full https URL of the x402 endpoint to evaluate, e.g. https://api.example.com/resource

name: check_x402_reliability
title: Check an x402 endpoint reliability score
